page: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8573C processor running up to 4.2 GHz. It is provisioned with 1 physical core presenting 2 dedicated vCPUs via hyperthreading, backed by 8.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Cache infrastructure provides 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and access to a 260 MB L3 pool. The processor exposes vector and matrix instruction extensions including AVX-512, AMX Tile, and AMX INT8, along with cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA-NI.

Storage consists of 118 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD capacity, offering direct low-latency disk operations. There are no discrete GPUs allocated to this instance type. Network allocations do not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate solid single-thread performance alongside bounded multi-core scalability due to the dual-thread configuration. Single-threaded tasks such as gzip compression test in the top quartile at 31.2 GB/sec, while single-core Geekbench measures at 1661.0. Conversely, parallel execution drops to the lowest percentiles, yielding a Geekbench multi-core score of 2015.0 and Clang software compilation score of 2128.0. Memory bandwidth remains constrained on uncached workloads, recording 20.87 GB/sec for 256 MB block reads and 13.93 GB/sec for writes.

The presence of local NVMe storage and dedicated vCPU execution creates a viable environment for entry-level workloads requiring fast local scratch space. However, total compute density and memory throughput restrict its suitability for concurrent multi-threaded workloads or large data processing. Appropriate deployments include small web servers, light database caching nodes, low-concurrency application hosting, and development environments.
description: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v6 is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at up to 4.2 GHz. The machine provides 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from a single physical core, 8.0 GB of memory, and 118 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage. It includes hardware acceleration for AVX-512 and AMX instructions without discrete GPUs. Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-threaded throughput, reaching 31.2 GB/sec in gzip compression, while multi-core metrics reflect the limited physical core count with a Geekbench multi-core score of 2015.0. Memory throughput reaches 20.87 GB/sec on uncached reads. Configured with a 1:4 core-to-memory ratio and fast temporary disk storage, the D2ds_v6 is suited for lightweight web serving, development instances, and entry-level transactional databases requiring local high-speed caching.
